Set knbsdata options

Source: R/options.R
knbs_options.Rd

Sets package options for the current session. Arguments left as NULL are unchanged. Called with no arguments, returns the current values.

Usage

knbs_options(
  cache = NULL,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  timeout = NULL,
  retries = NULL,
  user_agent = NULL,
  quiet = NULL
)

Arguments

cache

TRUE or FALSE. Whether retrieval functions may read from and write to the local cache.

cache_dir

Path to the cache directory. NULL uses tools::R_user_dir("knbsdata", "cache").

timeout

Request timeout in seconds.

retries

Maximum number of retries for retryable HTTP failures.

user_agent

Override for the HTTP user agent string. NULL uses a transparent default identifying the package and version.

quiet

TRUE or FALSE. Whether to suppress progress messages.

Value

When setting, the previous values as a named list, invisibly. When called with no arguments, the current values as a named list.

Details

To restore an option to its default, use options() directly, for example options(knbsdata.cache_dir = NULL), or withr::with_options() for a temporary change.

See also

knbs_option() to read a single option.

Examples

old <- knbs_options(timeout = 60)
knbs_option("timeout")
#> [1] 60

# restore
knbs_options(timeout = old$timeout)
